description: This file defines the RecursiveInterlockedExchangeLock class, a lightweight recursive lock implementation for thread synchronization within the Orleans.Threading namespace. It provides methods for acquiring and releasing the lock, with spin-waiting support.

classes.name: RecursiveInterlockedExchangeLock
classes.description: A lightweight recursive lock that manages access within the same thread using an integer lock state and spin-waiting when contention occurs.

methods.name: TryGet
methods.description: Attempts to acquire the lock without blocking, returning true if successful or if already held by the calling thread.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Blocks and waits until the lock is acquired, using spin-waiting if necessary.

methods.name: TryRelease
methods.description: Attempts to release the lock if held by the calling thread, returning true if successful.
